Extranet Resource Get All Extranets Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/extranet/lite

Retrieves the name-ID pairs of all extranets configured for an organization

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int64

A unique identifier for an entity

name
string

The configured name of the entity

externalId
string

An external identifier used for an entity that is managed outside of ZIA. Examples include zpaServerGroup and zpaAppSegments. This field is not applicable to ZIA-managed entities.

extensions
object
]
